## Research Question

How does my daily usage of five apps vary over two weeks?

## Data

I recorded daily usage of Xiaohongshu, Fanqie Novel, QQ, Douyin, and WeChat from October 12 to October 25, 2026.

The dataset contains 70 observations. Each observation represents one app on one day. Usage is measured in minutes.

Source: Apple Screen Time.

```{r}
screen_time <- read.csv("screen_time.csv")
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
screen_time$plot_date <- as.Date(
  screen_time$date,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)
```

## Visualization
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Import data
screen_time <- read_csv("screen_time.csv") |>
  mutate(
    plot_date = mdy(date)
  )

# Calculate total usage for each day
daily_totals <- screen_time |>
  group_by(plot_date) |>
  summarize(
    total = sum(minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate average daily screen time
avg_time <- mean(daily_totals$total)

# Identify the three highest-usage days
high_days <- daily_totals |>
  slice_max(total, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE)

# Define the original app colors
app_colors <- c(
  "Douyin" = "#FF6961",
  "Fanqie Novel" = "#A3AD00",
  "QQ" = "#00C78C",
  "WeChat" = "#00BFEA",
  "Xiaohongshu" = "#E74DEB"
)

# Create the revised visualization
ggplot(
  screen_time,
  aes(x = plot_date, y = minutes, fill = app)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +

  # Average daily screen time reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = avg_time,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray30",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Highlight the three highest-usage days
  geom_point(
    data = high_days,
    aes(x = plot_date, y = total),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  # Show total minutes on these days
  geom_text(
    data = high_days,
    aes(
      x = plot_date,
      y = total,
      label = paste0(total, " min")
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.9,
    size = 3.2
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = app_colors) +

  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 days",
    date_labels = "%m/%d",
    limits = as.Date(c("2026-10-11", "2026-10-26"))
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "My Screen Time Across Five Apps",
    subtitle = "October 12–25, 2026",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Daily Usage (minutes)",
    fill = "App",
    caption = paste0(
      "Dashed line = daily average (",
      round(avg_time),
      " min) | Dots = 3 highest-usage days\n",
      "Jiwei | Source: Apple Screen Time"
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 1,
      size = 9
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

  filename = "screen_time_v2.png",

  units = "in",

)
